title: XP HP and SP bars location

posts.author: Arcanum-edge
posts.body:
Hello,
I used to be on HBgames a very long time ago and I figured I'd return to forum land here looking for help with an RPG maker xp related issue. I was working with
This
battle system when I ran across a graphical bug. There were quite a few bugs with this system honestly, but I managed to fix the ones with the item and skill window. But I got stuck on the HP and SP bars for targeting a character. They are quite out of place.
I want the bars to fit neatly inside the bitmap that it sort of already fits in. But I can't find the script that references the bars so I am stuck. Any help would be most appreciated!
Thanks,
Arc.
Oh, also the text for Health and Spirit, $data_system.words.hp and $data_system.words.sp, is a little too transparent for my liking. It would be neat to find out how to change that as well.
EDIT: So, I figured out the positioning of the status bars in the help window by editing the default Window_Help. Apparently the script makes a second help window for under the skill and item windows and the values I was trying to edit were tied to that instead of the default one. Still haven't figured out how to adjust transparency on the text, but I imagine it's not that hard. This thread can be closed now unless someone wants to point me in the right direction for the transparency bit.
